newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Metlife busy in giant bookover deal.
newsitem.headline: Metlife busy in giant bookover deal.

text.p: Metropolitan Life shares were busy on Wednesday after a giant bookover deal boosted volumes, dealers said.

The deal, where one broker matches both buyer and seller, covered 3.85 million shares and was worth about 34 million rand. The firm's share edged up two cents to 892 cents and Metlife was the busiest stock on the bourse in early trade.
But by 0830 GMT stocks had edged back to overnight closing levels of 890 cents.
Market sources said the deal had been carried out by brokers Martindale Stacey du Toit (Pty) Ltd and had been between two local clients.
